Acne Vulgaris.name: Acne Vulgaris
Acne Vulgaris.description: A common skin condition that occurs when hair follicles become clogged with oil and dead skin cells, leading to pimples and breakouts.

Anemia.name: Anemia
prevention: eat a balanced diet with iron-rich foods
Anemia.description: A condition in which the blood lacks enough healthy red blood cells or hemoglobin, leading to reduced oxygen flow to the body's organs.

Asthma.name: Asthma
prevention: avoid known allergens and asthma triggers
Asthma.description: A chronic condition in which the airways narrow, swell, and produce extra mucus, making breathing difficult and triggering coughing and wheezing.

Bronchitis.name: Bronchitis
risk_factors: exposure to irritants on the job
prevention: wear a mask in polluted areas
Bronchitis.description: Inflammation of the lining of the bronchial tubes, which carry air to and from your lungs, often leading to a persistent mucus cough.

Cellulitis.name: Cellulitis
symptoms: skin that is warm to the touch
medical_treatment: surgical drainage if an abscess forms
prevention: wash cuts/scrapes immediately with soap and water
keep skin moisturized to prevent cracks
Cellulitis.description: A common and potentially serious bacterial skin infection that causes swelling, redness, and pain, usually on the lower legs.

Common Cold.name: Common Cold
prevention: avoid close contact with sick individuals
Common Cold.description: A viral infection of your nose and throat (upper respiratory tract) that is usually harmless, though it may feel unpleasant.

COVID-19.name: COVID-19
prevention: wear a mask in crowded areas
COVID-19.description: An infectious disease caused by the SARS-CoV-2 virus, leading to respiratory symptoms that range from mild to life-threatening.

Dandruff (Seborrheic Dermatitis).name: Dandruff (Seborrheic Dermatitis)
home_remedies: tea tree oil drops in shampoo
prevention: shampoo regularly if you have oily scalp
Dandruff (Seborrheic Dermatitis).description: A common condition characterized by flaking skin on the scalp, which can be accompanied by itching and redness.

Dengue Fever.name: Dengue Fever
risk_factors: living or traveling in tropical/subtropical regions
previous infection with a different dengue serotype
medical_treatment: blood transfusion in severe hemorrhagic cases
medications: acetaminophen (avoid ibuprofen/aspirin to reduce bleeding risks)
prevention: remove standing water around the home
Dengue Fever.description: A painful, mosquito-borne viral infection that causes high fever and severe flu-like symptoms, with a risk of developing severe hemorrhagic fever.

Eczema (Atopic Dermatitis).name: Eczema (Atopic Dermatitis)
risk_factors: family history of eczema or asthma
Eczema (Atopic Dermatitis).description: A chronic condition that makes the skin red, dry, and extremely itchy, often starting in childhood.

Food Poisoning.name: Food Poisoning
Food Poisoning.description: An illness caused by eating contaminated food, typically resulting in stomach upset, severe vomiting, and diarrhea.

Gastroenteritis (Stomach Bug).name: Gastroenteritis (Stomach Bug)
Gastroenteritis (Stomach Bug).description: An inflammation of the stomach and intestines, usually caused by a viral or bacterial infection, presenting with vomiting and diarrhea.

Hives (Urticaria).name: Hives (Urticaria)
Hives (Urticaria).description: A skin reaction that causes red, swollen, and intensely itchy welts, ranging in size and appearing anywhere on the body.

Hypertension (High Blood Pressure).name: Hypertension (High Blood Pressure)
Hypertension (High Blood Pressure).description: A common condition in which the long-term force of the blood against your artery walls is high enough that it may cause heart disease.

Impetigo.name: Impetigo
home_remedies: washing sores with mild soap and water
cutting nails short to prevent scratching
prevention: keep cuts and scrapes clean and covered
wash infected person's clothes and linens
Impetigo.description: A highly contagious bacterial skin infection that causes red sores, mainly on the face, which rupture and form honey-colored crusts.

Influenza (Flu).name: Influenza (Flu)
prevention: avoid close contact with infected individuals
Influenza (Flu).description: A common viral infection of the respiratory tract that causes fever, muscle aches, headache, fatigue, and coughing.

Jaundice.name: Jaundice
prevention: get vaccinated against Hepatitis A and B
practice safe hygiene and food preparation
Jaundice.description: A yellow discoloration of the skin and eyes caused by high levels of bilirubin in the blood, indicating potential liver or gallbladder issues.
Jaundice.recovery_time: Weeks to months depending on the cause

Kidney Stones.name: Kidney Stones
symptoms: severe pain in side and back
risk_factors: diet high in protein, sodium, and sugar
medications: alpha blockers to relax the ureter
prevention: stay hydrated by drinking water throughout the day
Kidney Stones.description: Hard deposits made of minerals and salts that form inside your kidneys, causing severe pain when they travel down the urinary tract.

Lyme Disease.name: Lyme Disease
risk_factors: spending time in wooded or grassy areas
having exposed skin in tick habitats
medical_treatment: intravenous antibiotic therapy for neurological complications
prevention: wear long sleeves/pants in wooded areas
check body for ticks after outdoor activities
Lyme Disease.description: A tick-borne bacterial infection characterized by a distinctive 'bulls-eye' rash, fever, fatigue, and joint pain.

Malaria.name: Malaria
risk_factors: traveling to or living in tropical regions
medical_treatment: hospitalization and monitoring in severe cases
Malaria.description: A serious, potentially life-threatening disease spread by infected Anopheles mosquitoes, causing cyclic fevers, chills, and flu-like symptoms.

Melanoma (Skin Cancer).name: Melanoma (Skin Cancer)
symptoms: development of a new pigmented or unusual looking growth
home_remedies: regular self-examinations (no home remedies for cancer treatment)
prevention: regularly check skin for changing moles
Melanoma (Skin Cancer).description: The most serious type of skin cancer, developing in the cells (melanocytes) that produce melanin, which gives skin its color.

Norovirus.name: Norovirus
risk_factors: eating in crowded settings (schools, cruise ships)
prevention: wash hands with soap and water
wash fruits/vegetables and cook seafood thoroughly
Norovirus.description: A highly contagious virus that causes sudden onset of severe vomiting and watery diarrhea, commonly known as food poisoning or stomach flu.

Osteoarthritis.name: Osteoarthritis
prevention: stay physically active with low-impact exercises
Osteoarthritis.description: The most common form of arthritis, characterized by the gradual wearing down of the protective cartilage on the ends of your bones.

Pneumonia.name: Pneumonia
Pneumonia.description: An infection that inflames the air sacs in one or both lungs, which may fill with fluid or pus, causing cough, fever, and difficulty breathing.

Psoriasis.name: Psoriasis
symptoms: red patches of skin covered with thick, silvery scales
dry, cracked skin that may bleed
Psoriasis.description: A chronic autoimmune disease that speeds up the growth cycle of skin cells, leading to thick, red, scaly patches that itch and burn.

Q Fever.name: Q Fever
risk_factors: being a veterinarian or laboratory worker
prevention: avoid contact with animal birth fluids
get vaccinated if in high-risk professions
Q Fever.description: A bacterial infection caused by Coxiella burnetii, typically transmitted to humans from farm animals, causing acute flu-like illness.

Ringworm (Fungal Infection).name: Ringworm (Fungal Infection)
risk_factors: close contact with infected animals or people
Ringworm (Fungal Infection).description: A highly contagious fungal infection of the skin or scalp that produces an itchy, red, circular rash resembling a ring.

Rosacea.name: Rosacea
medical_treatment: electrosurgery to remove visible blood vessels
prevention: use gentle cleansers and daily sunscreen
avoid triggers (spicy food, hot drinks, wind, sun)
Rosacea.description: A chronic inflammatory skin condition that causes redness, visible blood vessels, and small red bumps on the face, mainly the cheeks and nose.

Scabies.name: Scabies
risk_factors: close physical contact with an infected person
home_remedies: washing all clothes in hot water
medical_treatment: treatment of all household members simultaneously
prevention: avoid direct skin contact with infected individuals
wash all bedding and clothing in hot water and dry on high heat
Scabies.description: An itchy skin condition caused by microscopic mites that burrow into the upper layer of the skin to live and lay eggs.

Skin Allergy (Contact Dermatitis).name: Skin Allergy (Contact Dermatitis)
risk_factors: exposure to allergens (poison ivy, nickel, latex, cosmetics)
prevention: apply barrier creams or wear gloves
Skin Allergy (Contact Dermatitis).description: An allergic skin reaction resulting from direct contact with an irritating substance or allergen, causing redness, itching, and rashes.

Tuberculosis.name: Tuberculosis
medications: antibiotics (isoniazid, rifampin, ethambutol, pyrazinamide) for 6-9 months
prevention: get the BCG vaccine (in high-risk areas)
wear a mask in TB exposure settings
Tuberculosis.description: A serious infectious bacterial disease that mainly affects the lungs, spread through tiny droplets released into the air.

Ulcerative Colitis.name: Ulcerative Colitis
symptoms: diarrhea often with blood or pus
prevention: maintain a food diary to avoid trigger foods
Ulcerative Colitis.description: An inflammatory bowel disease that causes long-lasting inflammation and ulcers in the innermost lining of the large intestine and rectum.

Vertigo.name: Vertigo
prevention: perform head exercises recommended by doctor
Vertigo.description: A sensation of spinning or dizziness, often caused by problems in the inner ear or brain, resulting in a loss of balance.
Vertigo.recovery_time: A few hours to several weeks

Vitiligo.name: Vitiligo
symptoms: premature whitening or graying of hair
loss of color in tissues that line inside of mouth
prevention: protect skin from sun with sunscreen and clothing
Vitiligo.description: A condition in which the skin loses its pigment-producing cells (melanocytes), resulting in irregular discolored patches on the skin and hair.

Warts.name: Warts
Warts.description: Small, non-cancerous skin growths caused by a human papillomavirus (HPV) infection in the top layer of skin.

Whooping Cough (Pertussis).name: Whooping Cough (Pertussis)
symptoms: high-pitched intake of breath that sounds like 'whoop'
Whooping Cough (Pertussis).description: A highly contagious bacterial respiratory tract infection characterized by severe hacking coughs followed by a high-pitched 'whooping' sound.

Xeroderma Pigmentosum.name: Xeroderma Pigmentosum
symptoms: severe sunburn from very small sunlight
prevention: strict, total protection from ultraviolet (UV) light
installing UV filters on indoor windows
Xeroderma Pigmentosum.description: A rare inherited skin disorder characterized by an extreme sensitivity to ultraviolet (UV) rays, causing severe skin damage and a massive risk of skin cancer.

Yellow Fever.name: Yellow Fever
symptoms: muscle aches (especially in back and knees)
risk_factors: living in or traveling to jungle/forested areas of Africa/South America
home_remedies: plenty of fluids to prevent dehydration
medications: supportive drugs (avoid aspirin/NSAIDs due to bleeding risks)
prevention: get the yellow fever vaccine before traveling
Yellow Fever.description: A viral infection spread by mosquitoes in tropical regions, causing severe headaches, fever, and jaundice, which can lead to organ failure and bleeding.

Zika Virus.name: Zika Virus
risk_factors: traveling to areas with active Zika transmission
unprotected sex with an infected partner
medications: acetaminophen (avoid NSAIDs like aspirin until dengue is ruled out)
prevention: avoid travel to Zika-affected areas if pregnant
Zika Virus.description: A virus transmitted primarily by Aedes mosquitoes, causing mild symptoms like fever and rash, but linked to birth defects (microcephaly) in infants born to infected mothers.

Diabetes Type 1.name: Diabetes Type 1
prevention: no known prevention for Type 1 diabetes
Diabetes Type 1.description: An autoimmune condition in which the pancreas produces little or no insulin, the hormone needed to allow sugar (glucose) to enter cells.

Diabetes Type 2.name: Diabetes Type 2
Diabetes Type 2.description: A chronic condition that affects the way the body processes blood sugar (glucose), marked by insulin resistance or insufficient insulin production.
Diabetes Type 2.recovery_time: Chronic (can be put into remission with intensive lifestyle changes)

Gestational Diabetes.name: Gestational Diabetes
home_remedies: eating healthy foods (high fiber, low fat/sugar)
medical_treatment: frequent blood sugar testing during pregnancy
prevention: maintain a healthy weight before pregnancy
eat healthy foods and stay active before and during pregnancy
Gestational Diabetes.description: A type of diabetes that develops during pregnancy in women who did not previously have diabetes, caused by pregnancy hormones affecting insulin action.
Gestational Diabetes.recovery_time: Resolves shortly after childbirth (increased risk of future Type 2)

Appendicitis.name: Appendicitis
home_remedies: clear fluid diet (temporary before emergency hospital evaluation)
prevention: no specific prevention (diet high in fiber might reduce risk)
Appendicitis.description: An inflammation of the appendix, a finger-shaped pouch that projects from your colon, representing a medical emergency due to rupture risks.

Alzheimer's Disease.name: Alzheimer's Disease
prevention: engage in regular mental and physical activities
Alzheimer's Disease.description: A progressive disease that destroys memory and other important mental functions, representing the most common cause of dementia.

Alopecia.name: Alopecia
prevention: maintain a balanced diet rich in iron and protein
Alopecia.description: A condition that causes hair to fall out, ranging from small patches (alopecia areata) to total body hair loss (alopecia universalis).

Bipolar Disorder.name: Bipolar Disorder
risk_factors: having a first-degree relative with bipolar
prevention: monitor mood and identify early triggers
Bipolar Disorder.description: A mental health condition that causes extreme mood swings that include emotional highs (mania or hypomania) and lows (depression).

Bell's Palsy.name: Bell's Palsy
prevention: no specific prevention (managing stress and maintaining immunity might help)
Bell's Palsy.description: A temporary condition that causes weakness or paralysis of the muscles on one side of the face, usually resolving completely.

Celiac Disease.name: Celiac Disease
prevention: no prevention (gluten avoidance completely halts symptoms)
Celiac Disease.description: A serious autoimmune reaction to eating gluten, a protein found in wheat, barley, and rye, which damages the small intestine lining.
Celiac Disease.recovery_time: Months to years for intestinal healing

Chickenpox.name: Chickenpox
medications: acetaminophen (avoid aspirin due to Reye's syndrome)
Chickenpox.description: A highly contagious viral infection causing an itchy, blister-like rash on the skin along with fever and body aches.

Cholera.name: Cholera
Cholera.description: An acute diarrheal illness caused by infection of the intestine with the Vibrio cholerae bacteria, leading to rapid, life-threatening dehydration.

Depression (Clinical).name: Depression (Clinical)
prevention: get regular exercise and avoid isolation
Depression (Clinical).description: A mood disorder causing a persistent feeling of sadness and loss of interest, significantly impairing daily functioning.

Dermatitis (Contact / Seborrheic).name: Dermatitis (Contact / Seborrheic)
Dermatitis (Contact / Seborrheic).description: A general term for skin inflammation, resulting in red, itchy, and irritated skin rashes from direct contact with substances.

Epilepsy.name: Epilepsy
prevention: control high blood pressure to prevent stroke
practice good hygiene to avoid brain infections
Epilepsy.description: A neurological disorder marked by sudden recurrent episodes of sensory disturbance, loss of consciousness, or convulsions, associated with abnormal electrical activity in the brain.

Endometriosis.name: Endometriosis
prevention: no specific prevention (lowering estrogen levels via exercise and diet can help)
Endometriosis.description: An often painful disorder in which tissue similar to the tissue that normally lines the inside of your uterus grows outside your uterus.

Fibromyalgia.name: Fibromyalgia
prevention: no prevention (managing stress, maintaining physical activity, and good sleep can prevent flares)
Fibromyalgia.description: A disorder characterized by widespread musculoskeletal pain accompanied by fatigue, sleep, memory, and mood issues.

Gout.name: Gout
risk_factors: diet high in purines (red meat, seafood)
Gout.description: A common and painful form of inflammatory arthritis that usually affects one joint at a time (often the big toe), caused by uric acid crystal buildup.

GERD (Acid Reflux).name: GERD (Acid Reflux)
risk_factors: eating large meals or lying down immediately after eating
prevention: don't lie down for 3 hours after eating
GERD (Acid Reflux).description: A digestive disorder that occurs when stomach acid repeatedly flows back into the tube connecting your mouth and stomach (esophagus).

Glaucoma.name: Glaucoma
medications: prescription eye drops (prostaglandin analogs, beta blockers, alpha agonists)
prevention: know your family history of eye disease
exercise safely to lower eye pressure
Glaucoma.description: A group of eye conditions that damage the optic nerve, the health of which is vital for good vision, often caused by abnormally high pressure in your eye.

Hyperthyroidism.name: Hyperthyroidism
risk_factors: personal history of chronic illnesses like type 1 diabetes
prevention: no specific prevention (manage iodine intake if predisposed)
Hyperthyroidism.description: A condition in which the thyroid gland produces too much of the hormone thyroxine, accelerating the body's metabolism.

Hypothyroidism.name: Hypothyroidism
prevention: no specific prevention (ensuring adequate dietary iodine is helpful)
Hypothyroidism.description: A condition in which the thyroid gland doesn't produce enough thyroid hormone, slowing down the body's metabolic processes.

Hepatitis B.name: Hepatitis B
prevention: never share needles or personal grooming items
Hepatitis B.description: A serious liver infection caused by the hepatitis B virus (HBV), which can become chronic and lead to liver failure, cirrhosis, or liver cancer.

Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS).name: Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS)
Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS).description: A common gastrointestinal disorder affecting the large intestine, characterized by abdominal pain, cramping, bloating, and changes in bowel habits.

Insomnia.name: Insomnia
prevention: limit caffeine, alcohol, and large meals before bed
Insomnia.description: A common sleep disorder that makes it hard to fall asleep, hard to stay asleep, or causes you to wake up too early and not be able to get back to sleep.

Juvenile Rheumatoid Arthritis.name: Juvenile Rheumatoid Arthritis
prevention: no known prevention (early diagnosis halts joint damage)
Juvenile Rheumatoid Arthritis.description: The most common type of arthritis in children under 16, causing persistent joint pain, swelling, and stiffness.
Juvenile Rheumatoid Arthritis.recovery_time: Chronic (periods of active flare and remission)

Kawasaki Disease.name: Kawasaki Disease
home_remedies: cool sponge baths (note: this is a medical emergency requiring hospitalization)
prevention: no known prevention (early treatment prevents coronary artery aneurysms)
Kawasaki Disease.description: An acute inflammatory illness of the blood vessels, mainly affecting children under 5, which can lead to serious heart complications if untreated.

Lupus.name: Lupus
risk_factors: race (more common in African Americans, Hispanics, Asians)
prevention: avoid direct sunlight, manage stress, get regular physical activity, and quit smoking
Lupus.description: A systemic autoimmune disease that occurs when your body's immune system attacks your own tissues and organs, causing widespread inflammation.

Leukemia.name: Leukemia
home_remedies: avoiding raw foods to prevent infection
Leukemia.description: A cancer of the body's blood-forming tissues, including the bone marrow and the lymphatic system, resulting in the overproduction of abnormal white blood cells.
Leukemia.recovery_time: Varies (long-term treatment over months to years)

Migraine.name: Migraine
home_remedies: resting in a dark quiet room
prevention: maintain regular sleep and meal schedules
identify and avoid trigger foods (aged cheese, MSG)
Migraine.description: A neurological condition that causes intense, throbbing headaches, often accompanied by nausea, vomiting, and extreme sensitivity to light and sound.

Meningitis.name: Meningitis
home_remedies: hydration (note: this is a medical emergency requiring immediate hospital care)
Meningitis.description: An inflammation of the fluid and membranes (meninges) surrounding your brain and spinal cord, representing a medical emergency when bacterial.

Multiple Sclerosis.name: Multiple Sclerosis
prevention: no specific prevention (maintaining healthy vitamin D and quitting smoking may reduce risks)
Multiple Sclerosis.description: A disease in which the immune system eats away at the protective sheath (myelin) that covers nerves, disrupting communication between the brain and body.

Narcolepsy.name: Narcolepsy
home_remedies: avoiding caffeine or alcohol close to bedtime
prevention: no known prevention (early diagnosis and management prevents accidents)
Narcolepsy.description: A chronic sleep disorder characterized by overwhelming daytime drowsiness and sudden attacks of sleep, often with a temporary loss of muscle control.

Osteoporosis.name: Osteoporosis
prevention: ensure adequate calcium and vitamin D intake
Osteoporosis.description: A condition in which bones become weak and brittle, making them highly susceptible to fractures, even from minor stress or falls.

Otitis Media (Ear Infection).name: Otitis Media (Ear Infection)
medical_treatment: myringotomy (ear tubes) for chronic fluid build-up
Otitis Media (Ear Infection).description: An infection of the middle ear, the air-filled space behind the eardrum, commonly presenting with severe earache and fluid buildup.

Parkinson's Disease.name: Parkinson's Disease
prevention: some research suggests regular aerobic exercise and caffeine consumption may reduce risks
Parkinson's Disease.description: A progressive nervous system disorder that affects movement, starting with barely noticeable tremors and progressing to rigid muscles and slowed motion.

Pancreatitis.name: Pancreatitis
symptoms: upper abdominal pain radiating to back
prevention: maintain a healthy weight to prevent gallstones
Pancreatitis.description: Inflammation of the pancreas, an organ behind the stomach that secretes digestive enzymes, representing an acute emergency or a chronic painful state.

Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS).name: Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS)
prevention: maintain a healthy weight through active lifestyle and balanced diet to control insulin levels
Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS).description: A hormonal disorder common among women of reproductive age, characterized by irregular periods, excess androgen levels, and cyst-covered ovaries.

Angioedema.name: Angioedema
prevention: avoid known allergens and trigger medications
carry an epinephrine auto-injector if prescribed
Angioedema.description: An area of swelling in the deep layers of the skin, often seen around the eyes, lips, or hands, which can become life-threatening if it blocks the airway.

Rheumatoid Arthritis.name: Rheumatoid Arthritis
prevention: avoid joint trauma and stay active
Rheumatoid Arthritis.description: A chronic progressive autoimmune disorder that primarily attacks the joints, causing painful swelling that can eventually result in bone erosion and joint deformity.

Rabies.name: Rabies
risk_factors: being bitten or scratched by wild animals (bats, raccoons, dogs)
traveling to regions with high rabies prevalence
home_remedies: washing animal bite wound with soap and water immediately (note: rabies has no home cure and requires emergency medical intervention)
medical_treatment: intensive supportive ICU care (symptomatic rabies is almost 100% fatal)
medications: rabies immune globulin (HRIG) administered immediately post-exposure
prevention: receive pre-exposure vaccination if at high risk
Rabies.description: A deadly viral disease spread to humans from the saliva of infected animals, causing acute inflammation of the brain and nervous system.
Rabies.recovery_time: Fatal if symptoms appear (vaccine prevents onset)

Stroke.name: Stroke
home_remedies: call emergency services immediately (no home remedies; time is brain)
prevention: maintain a healthy weight and exercise
manage diabetes and eat a low-sodium diet
Stroke.description: A medical emergency that occurs when the blood supply to part of your brain is interrupted or reduced, preventing brain tissue from getting oxygen and nutrients.

Shingles (Herpes Zoster).name: Shingles (Herpes Zoster)
medical_treatment: pain management clinics for postherpetic neuralgia
Shingles (Herpes Zoster).description: A viral infection caused by the reactivation of the varicella-zoster virus (the chickenpox virus), resulting in a painful, blistering skin rash on one side of the body.

Sinusitis.name: Sinusitis
prevention: use a humidifier if air is dry
Sinusitis.description: Inflammation or swelling of the tissue lining the sinuses, causing mucus buildup, nasal blockage, and facial pressure.

Tonsillitis.name: Tonsillitis
symptoms: white or yellow coating on tonsils
risk_factors: frequent exposure to viral or bacterial germs (school settings)
prevention: avoid sharing food, drinking glasses, or utensils
Tonsillitis.description: An inflammation of the tonsils, the two oval-shaped pads of tissue at the back of the throat, usually caused by a viral or bacterial infection.

Tetanus.name: Tetanus
risk_factors: being unvaccinated or overdue for booster
puncture wounds from rusty metal or dirt
home_remedies: wound care (cleaning cuts with antiseptic immediately) (note: tetanus requires immediate emergency hospital care)
prevention: get the tetanus vaccine and regular booster doses every 10 years
clean all wounds thoroughly and apply antiseptic
Tetanus.description: A serious bacterial disease caused by Clostridium tetani, which enters the body through cuts and produces a toxin that causes painful muscle spasms and lockjaw.

Urinary Tract Infection (UTI).name: Urinary Tract Infection (UTI)
symptoms: passing frequent small amounts of urine
Urinary Tract Infection (UTI).description: An infection in any part of the urinary system, including the kidneys, ureters, bladder, and urethra, most commonly affecting the bladder.

Varicose Veins.name: Varicose Veins
risk_factors: standing or sitting for long periods
home_remedies: avoiding long periods of sitting or standing
Varicose Veins.description: Gnarled, enlarged veins, most commonly appearing in the legs and feet, caused by weak or damaged vein valves.

Wilson's Disease.name: Wilson's Disease
home_remedies: low-copper diet (avoiding chocolate, mushrooms, shellfish, nuts)
using zinc supplements to block copper absorption
prevention: no prevention (inherited disease; genetic screening for family members allows early treatment to prevent damage)
Wilson's Disease.description: A rare inherited disorder that causes copper to accumulate in your liver, brain, and other vital organs, leading to liver failure or brain damage if untreated.

X-linked Agammaglobulinemia (XLA).name: X-linked Agammaglobulinemia (XLA)
prevention: no prevention (inherited; genetic counseling and regular IG infusions prevent life-threatening infections)
X-linked Agammaglobulinemia (XLA).description: An inherited primary immunodeficiency disorder in which the body cannot produce antibodies (immunoglobulins), leaving it highly vulnerable to bacterial infections.

Yeast Infection (Candidiasis).name: Yeast Infection (Candidiasis)
symptoms: burning sensation during intercourse or urination
prevention: wear cotton underwear and loose clothing
change out of wet swimsuits or gym clothes immediately
Yeast Infection (Candidiasis).description: A common fungal infection caused by an overgrowth of Candida yeast, most commonly affecting the vaginal area, causing itching, irritation, and discharge.

Zollinger-Ellison Syndrome.name: Zollinger-Ellison Syndrome
risk_factors: family history of Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia type 1 (MEN1)
medications: high-dose proton pump inhibitors (PPIs like omeprazole, lansoprazole)
prevention: no known prevention (genetic testing for MEN1 helps catch gastrinomas early before severe ulcers develop)
Zollinger-Ellison Syndrome.description: A rare condition in which one or more tumors (gastrinomas) form in your pancreas or the upper part of your small intestine, secreting large amounts of gastrin that cause severe stomach ulcers.
